map.自书遗嘱须由本人亲笔书写、签名并注明年月日才有效；本工具仅生成内容，形式要件仍需: A holographic will is valid only if written by the testator by hand, signed and dated; this tool only produces the content, and the formal requirements must still be met.
map.自书遗嘱无需见证人；代书、打印、录音录像、口头遗嘱需两名以上见证人，且见证人不能: A holographic will needs no witnesses; dictated, printed, audio-visual and oral wills need two or more witnesses, who may not be heirs or interested persons.
